source: Rust-Oleum, Ultimate Polyurethane Technical Data Sheet ROC-23, revision 021315.
tolerance: The engine's 11 m²/L coverage estimate falls within the converted 9.8169–12.2712 m²/L practical range; the 120-minute recoat interval matches the TDS exactly.
scope: Validates coverage compatibility and recoat interval only for this named product. The TDS specifies 7 days to full cure while the engine estimates 48 hours; cure and volume (including differing waste assumptions) are explicitly excluded.
